propositions: Project criteria activated via _project_criteria are re-routed independently and bypass probe allowlist filtering, causing extra billable LLM calls during probe mode that should be suppressed.
The probe allowlist (E4/G1G2) reaches workflow through gate input probe_criteria but is not threaded to the batch step where project criteria are fanned in.
_project_criteria must filter activated project criteria to only those present in the probe allowlist when probing, mirroring the suppression applied to built-in criteria in workflow_ops.
The probe_criteria allowlist should be delivered to the batch runner via the existing BatchRunRequest.with_inputs seam without modifying the generic BatchRunRequest dataclass.
Monkeypatch stubs for _project_criteria in tests must be updated to accept a third parameter (probe allowlist) to avoid TypeError when the call site passes it.
